entries.rationale: The glue accepts the public 8-bit LED channels while the signed 32-bit guest ABI carries them to host-owned brightness policy.
Guest-local callback dispatch receives button events forwarded by the host lifecycle glue.
The device host owns overlay state, so the guest setter is intentionally a no-op.
The device host owns overlay state, so guests intentionally observe OVERLAY_OFF.
This hand-authored adapter mirrors only the ThingPulse methods available through the guest ABI.
The fixed-buffer Arduino compatibility surface is deliberately smaller and nonblocking in a guest module.
ESP logging macros intentionally compile out to avoid pulling formatted libc into guest modules.
This force-included compatibility aggregator supplies the device guest's intentionally reduced header set.
Guest lifecycle exports and host-state refresh are adapter glue with no firmware-header counterpart.
